2968420.name: PowerWash Simulator 2
2968420.short_description: PowerWash Simulator is back, bubbling with fresh locations, soap-erior equipment and splashy features. Effortlessly transform soiled surroundings into clean, serene scenes, solo or with pals. Satisfaction is a spray away!

3321460.name: Crimson Desert
3321460.short_description: Crimson Desert is an open-world action-adventure set on the continent of Pywel. Join Kliff on his journey to rebuild the Greymane faction and to save the land from a looming threat. From vast wilderness and cities to ruins and the mysterious Abyss, forge your path through battles and discovery.

4235160.name: Traders Life Simulator
4235160.short_description: Run your own shop in a first-person trading sim where you buy low, negotiate smart deals, and sell for profit.

1977570.name: A Dance of Fire and Ice - Neo Cosmos
1977570.short_description: Neo Cosmos is an expansion to A Dance of Fire and Ice: It features 5 new worlds, all-new surprise game mechanics, and music by Canblaster 2k6, Frums, Ash Astral, and DM Dokuro.

4274990.name: Minibus Simulator
4274990.short_description: Build your own minibus business and transport passengers across the city. Load luggage, maintain and wash your vehicle, unlock new routes and grow your transport career in a living city.

3390880.name: CAPTURED 2
3390880.short_description: You're trapped in an apartment with ever-changing rooms. Capture anomalies on camera, survive deadly entities and escape an endless nightmare.

595690.name: One Hour One Life
595690.short_description: A multiplayer survival game of parenting and civilization building. Get born to another player as your mother. Live an entire life in one hour. Have babies of your own in the form of other players. Leave a legacy for the next generation as you help to rebuild civilization from scratch.

2815070.name: RIDE 6
2815070.short_description: Live the thrill of asphalt and dirt with RIDE 6: affirm your biker identity by joining RIDE Fest, race with 250+ bikes from different categories and prove you're the best by challenging real motorcycling legends.

3551340.name: Football Manager 26
3551340.short_description: Step into the dugout and experience the future of football management.

1401730.name: Crashlands 2
1401730.short_description: Slap your way across a vibrant world where interstellar friendships are the key to your survival. Befriend eccentric aliens, craft bizarre weaponry, and stick it to the man in this sequel to the award-winning open world crafting RPG Crashlands.

4209010.name: Lakehopper
4209010.short_description: Take flight in a seaplane flight simulator through a rugged world where you are responsible for the care and maintenance of your plane. Deliver cargo between far-flung communities in a flooded landscape that challenges your piloting skills! Fix your plane and keep flying!

2300840.name: Subliminal
2300840.short_description: Subliminal is a psychological horror game inspired by the urban legend of The Backrooms. Bleeding edge lighting and rendering, handcrafted open-ended levels, light and perspective-based puzzles, nostalgic spaces, unfamiliar faces, and a rotting feeling that something is not quite right.

837470.name: Untitled Goose Game
837470.short_description: It's a lovely morning in the village and you are a horrible goose.

2778580.name: ELDEN RING Shadow of the Erdtree
2778580.short_description: The ELDEN RING Shadow of the Erdtree expansion features an all-new story set in the Land of Shadow imbued with mystery, perilous dungeons, and new enemies, weapons and equipment.

3477300.name: Scope X
3477300.short_description: The #1 screen magnification overlay for competitive FPS players. Instantly zoom into any part of your screen to spot distant targets, reveal critical details, and gain a visual edge. Built for shooters.

3180410.name: Project Songbird
3180410.short_description: Project Songbird is a cinematic first-person narrative horror game set in the Appalachian forest. Take on the role of Dakota, a musician who must record their new album in a remote log cabin amidst a writer's block. Take caution, however. These woods were never empty...

1962700.name: Subnautica 2
1962700.short_description: Subnautica 2 is an underwater survival adventure set on an all-new alien world, developed by Unknown Worlds. Play alone or with friends in 4-player co-op. Adapt to survive by building custom bases and crafting tools. Explore the unknown to uncover the mysteries hidden within the depths.

4479970.name: Scary Game 2: The Mad Shepherd
4479970.short_description: Your first day as the new shepherd in the village… and everything is going wrong. The animals are missing. The villagers are strange. And the truth is far more terrifying.

2483190.name: Forza Horizon 6
2483190.short_description: Discover the breathtaking landscapes of Japan in over 550 real-world cars and become a racing Legend in Forza Horizon's biggest open world driving adventure yet.

2681030.name: Outbound
2681030.short_description: Explore a colorful world and build your own cozy home on wheels. Craft workstations, and source energy from the sun, wind, or water. Upgrade and customize your vehicle, grow crops, and live sustainably off-grid with up to 4 players.

2215200.name: LEGO® Batman™: Legacy of the Dark Knight
2215200.short_description: Rise as the Dark Knight and experience the essential Batman story in a bold, action-packed adventure with hard-hitting combat, an open-world Gotham City, and the signature LEGO charm that fans know and love.

3190700.name: Midnight Looters
3190700.short_description: Midnight Looters is a 1-4 player co-op horror game where you and your friends explore mysterious forests to find valuable treasures. Face supernatural dangers, collect items, and upgrade your gear to survive the haunted woods.

3846650.name: The Perfect Shape
3846650.short_description: A minimalist puzzle game about geometry, perspective, and finding the perfect angle to complete beautiful shapes. Relax your mind with satisfying mechanics and clean aesthetics.

3499220.name: Chrono Shift
3499220.short_description: Manipulate time to solve mind-bending environmental puzzles and escape a decaying dystopian facility. Rewind, pause, and fast-forward world elements to carve your path forward.

2095420.name: Neon Override
2095420.short_description: A fast-paced, high-octane cyberpunk roguelike shooter. Hack systems, upgrade your cybernetics on the fly, and blast your way through endless corporate security forces.

3751950.name: Whispers of the Deep
3751950.short_description: An atmospheric psychological horror game set in an isolated deep-sea research station. Manage your oxygen, dodge terrifying marine entities, and discover what lurks below.

4173620.name: Supervive
4173620.short_description: An open-ended, neon-apocalyptic hero theorycrafting game where players form squads, hunt bosses, and battle other squads in massive, dynamic sky-bound battlegrounds.

617830.name: Supermarket Simulator
617830.short_description: Run your own supermarket. Stock shelves, set prices as you please, take payments, hire staff, expand and design your store. Online order & delivery, thieves, security, local market are included.

4333460.name: The Meter is Running
4333460.short_description: You inherited a taxi dispatch business but it came with debt attached. Hire drivers, dispatch fares, navigate Istanbul's chaos, deal with bad customers and worse luck. You have 15 days to pay it off or lose everything. The meter is running.

4704690.name: MECCHA CHAMELEON
4704690.short_description: Paint yourself to blend in! "Meccha Chameleon" is a new-sensation hide-and-seek game where you paint your white body to mimic the stage. Spot, pose, and "artistic skill" are keys to survival. Deceive Seekers with techniques that put chameleons to shame! Supports public matches and streaming.

3768760.name: 007 First Light
3768760.short_description: Earn the Number. 007 First Light is a thrilling espionage action-adventure game from IO Interactive. Follow James Bond as a young, resourceful and sometimes reckless recruit in MI6's training programme, and discover an origin story of the world’s most famous spy.

3859630.name: METAL GEAR SOLID: MASTER COLLECTION Vol.2
3859630.short_description: This second installment to the collection features “Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots” and “Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker (HD Collection version),” and also a digital soundtrack and "Metal Gear: Ghost Babel" as bonus content.

3898750.name: VoxMagic - Realtime Voice Changer
3898750.short_description: Your voice, your playground! VoxMagic is the ultimate sidekick: switch from kawaii girl to burly dude in game chats, swap personas mid‑stream, remix recordings or any audio file! Voice magic plus a variety of sound effects. No mix, EQ, or editing hassles—VoxMagic makes it easy!

2327720.name: City Car Driving 2.0
2327720.short_description: City Car Driving 2.0 is a driving simulator designed to help novice drivers master driving in a setting as close to reality as possible.

4286510.name: Plobania 47/B
4286510.short_description: Immortality is not a blessing, it is a burden. As Milton Clarke, you work at the 47/B Mandatory Sleep Hospital, review documents, surf the internet, and decide who will no longer exist. You don’t kill anyone. You only “put them to sleep.” The rules are clear. Every decision has consequences.

325724.name: Dying Light: The Following
325724.short_description: Experience the untold chapter of Kyle Crane's story set in a vast breathtaking region outside the city of Harran. Leave the city walls behind and discover a countryside full of mysterious characters, deadly weapons and blood-chilling quests.

3385970.name: Beyond Sandbox
3385970.short_description: Beyond Sandbox is a multiplayer VR modding platform powered by Unreal Engine 5. With advanced physics and the creativity of our modding community, anything is possible.

3476880.name: Brno Transit
3476880.short_description: A short narrative-driven psychological horror game about a trainee metro driver trapped in the dampest subway east of anything that matters.

2486930.name: Dark Riddle
2486930.short_description: Find out the scary secrets of the neighbor.

1962663.name: Call of Duty®: Warzone™
1962663.short_description: Welcome to Call of Duty®: Warzone™, the massive free-to-play combat arena. Experience thrilling modes & new gameplay features across three new geo updates in Fortune's Keep, Endgame (for a limited time), Battle Royale, Black Ops Royale, and Resurgence.

4450800.name: Idols of Ash
4450800.short_description: Grapple, clamber and fall thousands of meters down into a dark and ancient place in this first-person horror climbing game. You are being hunted.

2873660.name: Global Rescue
2873660.short_description: Build your own base and take command of firefighting, police, EMS, and SWAT operations. Thanks to real map data, you can play right in your hometown - or anywhere in the world! Manage your fleet, hire staff, and take on a variety of authentic operations. In which city are you taking command?

2302120.name: Infinitum: The Backrooms Story
2302120.short_description: INFINITUM is a horror open-world survival co-op story game for up to 4 players. Explore endless procedurally generated levels and uncover multiple endings, with every playthrough offering a unique experience.

4161620.name: Summer Delicious Simulator
4161620.short_description: Start your career on the bustling city streets as an ice cream or hotdog vendor! Upgrade your cart, outsmart your rivals, and compete with friends to become the most popular seller in town!

4157170.name: Sports Card Shop Simulator
4157170.short_description: Open packs, search for rare cards, and build the best sports card shop. Hunt for holos, autos, and numbered variants to satisfy your collection obsession. Design custom cards and enjoy the thrill of pulling those creations from a fresh pack!

2904040.name: Cheap Car Repair
2904040.short_description: Cheap Car Repair - go back in time to Poland of the 90's. Run your own Cheap Car Repair shop. Look for savings wherever you can. Make lots of money and avoid angry customers!

4669230.name: Traders Life Together
4669230.short_description: Start your supermarket business and make your own trading Journey! With Co-op support Play solo or team up with friends, featuring over 300 items you can make your dream store, enjoy it with your friends!

4530690.name: DEPLETED
4530690.short_description: DEPLETED is an asymmetrical multiplayer horror game where sacrifices must escape a ritualist who hunts them down for blood in order to complete the ritual. Use stealth, teamwork, and strategy to survive.

3475080.name: Roulette Heist
3475080.short_description: Step into the shadows of a luxurious nightclub casino, don your mask, and join 2 to 4 players in a deadly multiplayer game of wits and chance. Bullets are your only companions in this life-or-death showdown.

291480.name: Warface: Clutch
291480.short_description: 𝗪𝗮𝗿𝗳𝗮𝗰𝗲: 𝗖𝗹𝘂𝘁𝗰𝗵 𝗶𝘀 𝗮 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗺𝗽𝗼𝗿𝗮𝗿𝘆 𝗠𝗠𝗢 𝗳𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝗽𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗼𝗻 𝘀𝗵𝗼𝗼𝘁𝗲𝗿 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗺𝗶𝗹𝗹𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀 𝗼𝗳 𝗳𝗮𝗻𝘀 𝗮𝗿𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗹𝗱. 𝗜𝘁 𝗼𝗳𝗳𝗲𝗿𝘀 𝗶𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗲 𝗣𝘃𝗣 𝗺𝗼𝗱𝗲𝘀, 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝗹𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗣𝘃𝗘 𝗺𝗶𝘀𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗿𝗮𝗶𝗱𝘀 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗰𝗮𝗻 𝗰𝗵𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗲𝗻𝗴𝗲 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗳𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗱𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗲 𝗰𝗹𝗮𝘀𝘀𝗲𝘀 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗮 𝗰𝗼𝗹𝗼𝘀𝘀𝗮𝗹 𝗰𝘂𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗺𝗶𝘇𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲 𝗮𝗿𝘀𝗲𝗻𝗮𝗹.

3814170.name: Cross The Ages: Arise
3814170.short_description: A free multiplayer action-RPG where every battle tests your reflexes and strategy. Customize your hero, explore a mysterious world with your friends, and face fearsome enemies. Wield unique weapons and prove your worth in epic battles.

2660510.name: OCTOPinbs
2660510.short_description: OCTOPinbs is a social deduction multiplayer action game for 3-10 people. Is your fellow firefighter really putting out a fire...or are they actually setting the place ablaze!? Deal with collapsing floors and monitor adjacent rooms as you battle the flames.

4662560.name: For God and For Profit
4662560.short_description: For God and For Profit is a medieval-Renaissance investigation game. The player learns the essentials of accounting, then applies the principles to balance the book of records. Calm and cozy, yet culminating in thrilling interrogation.

3869090.name: Beta Kafe : Write Your Love Story
3869090.short_description: A man with a broken heart, trying to find sex and love—though it’s hard. In this dating simulation, you’ll be facing some of the most terrible first date experiences. It’s cinematic, funny, and brutally honest!

1858980.name: Gravity Game
1858980.short_description: A physics based, multiplayer melee shooter. Based on the classic game of sumo, your goal is to claim the ring in the middle. Use grenades, rockets and explosive melee weapons to push your opponents off the stage.

3453610.name: Hoover Heroes
3453610.short_description: Hoover Heroes is a chaotic, physics-based multiplayer battle game. Compete online with up to 8 friends in various game modes. In this wild competition full of unpredictable moments, laughter will be flying everywhere. May the best Kevin win!

2425130.name: Hacked: The Streamer
2425130.short_description: You are blackmailed in Hacked: The Streamer. Investigate clues, make impactful decisions, and shape your story to uncover the culprit is in this thrilling interactive movie. The fate of PinkyPie, a fan-favorite streamer, is in your hands.

3681580.name: Bowlers : The bowling experience
3681580.short_description: Bowlers is THE bowling simulation. Create your character, live an adventure, and progress from amateur games to the most prestigious professional tournaments!

2349100.name: Flipper Soccer
2349100.short_description: Play a quick game of Flipper Soccer - the game that mixes football with pinball. Control the flippers to score goals against your opponent, who can be your friend or the computer.

3381680.name: Age of History 2: Definitive Edition
3381680.short_description: The grand strategy classic returns with improved gameplay, a massive 13,892 province map, expanded diplomacy and wartime capitulation, new civilizations and scenarios, atomic weapons, smarter AI, enhanced visuals, UI upgrades, and major performance improvements.

3103280.name: DreamWorld: Sandbox MMO
3103280.short_description: Build incredible structures with powerful tools. Explore the world with all players on one server. Battle bosses, farm, craft, and socialize with friends. How will you shape DreamWorld?

3014580.name: Follow Us
3014580.short_description: 2-player asymmetrical co-op game, Follow Us is a hilarious and horrifying relationship stress test, where one player explores a spooky environment, while another guides them remotely from the van, trying to keep their partner alive.

3124540.name: Far Far West
3124540.short_description: Yee-haw, Cowboys! Team up in this chaotic 1-4 player co-op shooter. Journey to the Far Far West to blast monsters, sling spells, complete missions, and collect bounties. Work as a team to get in, get paid and get out (mostly) alive.

3916860.name: The Brewline
3916860.short_description: Step into the world of bootleg booze in this story-driven, single-player sim! Grow your crops, brew your drinks, bond with eccentric customers, and bottle it all under your own brand. Uncover the truth behind your brother’s arrest, complete quirky missions, and build your underground empire.

1575870.name: UpGun
1575870.short_description: Face your friends in UpGun! Use each round to accumulate skills and overtake your opponents in this crazy deathmatch!

3241020.name: GEORGIE-YOLKIE™ Enhanced
3241020.short_description: GEORGIE-YOLKIE™ is an all-new purrfect open-world platformer and collectathon! With huge, beautiful worlds, meet an unforgettable cast of silly characters as buddy-duo Georgie (The cat guy) and Yolkie (The yellow bird) embark on an epic, funny adventure to thwart the evil King Rattie! Now enhanced!

2271300.name: Safehouse
2271300.short_description: In Safehouse, play as a member of a criminal crew holed up in a Safehouse with a traitor among you working with the enemy to bring you down. Can you uncover their identity and eliminate them before they betray the crew?

3554630.name: VMX
3554630.short_description: Ride BMX, Scooters and MTB in a multiplayer VR skatepark while doing gesture-based tricks. Take on challenges in carefully crafted skateparks and dirt tracks, customize your bike with a realistic spray-painting system, and express your style through a variety of outfits.

1682380.name: Survive The Hill
1682380.short_description: Survive the Hill is an asymmetrical multiplayer/co-op survival experience that supports Solo and 4/8-player options and AI versus scenarios. Blow up the exit areas with your aim to escape. Look for ways to defeat the killer, build your strategy, never wander alone.

3041230.name: Windrose
3041230.short_description: Embark on a PvE survival adventure in the Age of Piracy. Fight on land and sea, solo or with friends. Build, craft and explore vast open world filled with dark secrets. Master soulslite combat and take on challenging bosses, command your ship and plunder unspoken treasures!

2387280.name: Operation Space Force
2387280.short_description: Join Operation Space Force, a free-to-play team-based shooter that takes place in space. Explore weapon customization and different heroes, your base, fight against enemies, and experience different game modes.

1939920.name: Cyber Clutch: Hot Import Nights
1939920.short_description: Cyber Clutch: Hot Import Nights is a high intensity arcade combat racer set in a neon future. Compete in ranked online races, unleash tactical abilities and outdrive rivals across chaotic circuits. Choose your ride, customize your style and dominate the track.

2120790.name: Ringborn
2120790.short_description: You are Idas, a woodcutter’s son thrust into a medieval world of power and impotence, of beauty and corruption. Enter the world of Ringborn and immerse yourself in a captivating story realised through deep combat, beautiful graphics and impactful player choice.

3634520.name: Samson
3634520.short_description: Samson returns to Tyndalston, a city that shaped him hard, where every fight is close and every escape is earned. He owes dangerous people more than he can pay, and they’re using his sister to force his hand. The clock is ticking. The only way out is through anyone who stands in his way.

1101180.name: EverStopped
1101180.short_description: STAND UP SOLDIER! Resume training! Become the best on this FPS Runner game demanding reflexes and precision!

4260570.name: The Krampus Game
4260570.short_description: The Krampus Game is a chaotic, scary-fun multiplayer adventure where ancient winter folklore turns into wild holiday mayhem. Inspired by real Krampus and Nikolaus parades, this game brings the tradition to life — but with more monsters, more laughs, and a whole lot more chaos.

938200.name: Metric Racer
938200.short_description: Race through future cities and across the surface of other planets to out run, out maneuver and out pace your competition. Metric Racer, a fast paced, cartoon shaded futuristic racer.

2504540.name: CUBE ROYALE
2504540.short_description: The agile multiplayer arcade battle royale experience for soldiers of fortune and strategy experts.

988250.name: TowerHex
988250.short_description: Set out on a magical virtual reality quest and explore the fantasy world of TowerHex. Open some portals, kill some dragons, become the hero and find the missing alchemist!

3844970.name: Burglin' Gnomes
3844970.short_description: An online Co-op game about breaking into houses and causing havoc as a tiny gnome. Avoid danger, repurpose stolen household items, and complete tasks to meet the High-Gnome’s demands. Craft equipment and upgrade your home to make your missions easier and more successful.

1297900.name: Gothic 1 Remake
1297900.short_description: The Legend is Back - Return to the Valley of the Mines in this faithful remake of the genre-defining classic RPG. Explore a hand-crafted, organic open world that reacts dynamically to your actions in a gritty, unrestricted experience like no other.

2224750.name: B1700
2224750.short_description: B1700 is a medieval fantasy game with PVP and PVE game modes. Boasting a vast selection of medieval weapons and armor in which players can loot to grow your character. Fight in the arena where each kill and death counts towards your battle rating, climb the leader boards and be number one!

1364980.name: project BLARI
1364980.short_description: Try to survive in this semi open horror game inspired by the ps1 graphic era.

2349430.name: Ancestral Players
2349430.short_description: Hurl fiery axes into rivals' faces, fire arrows with surgical precision, or blast your buddies with explosive coconuts. Paint the arena with the blood of your enemies in this chaotic, skill-based PvP shooter where death is your greatest power-up.

2358780.name: The Desolation
2358780.short_description: The Desolation brings a complete cross-platform co-op looter-shooter experience to PC and mobile devices. Make your impact across endless procedurally generated worlds via cooperative action combat, deep build customization and richly satisfying tactical gameplay.
